newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petro falls on dilution fears.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petro falls on dilution fears.

text.p: Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd H shares resumed trading in Hong Kong on Tuesday and fell as investors feared dilution following the firm's plans to place shares in the United States and Canada, brokers said.
The stock was down HK$0.125 or 5.56 percent at HK$2.125 in early trade on volume of 1.41 million shares.

"The market is adjusting down the price and narrowing the gap between the trading price and the placement price," said Kinson Au, analyst from PW Asia Brokerage. "Support is expected at a price close to the placement price."
Trading of the company's shares was suspended last Friday as it entered into an agreement to place American depositary shares in the U.S. and Canada.
Shanghai Petrochemical said last Friday it would place 500 million H shares globally at HK$2.075 each to institutional and professional investors.
